title: Pseudocompact Topological \(MV\)-Algebras
summary: Recently, topological MV-algebras have been investigated by several mathematicians. In this paper, we find that every topological \(MV\)-algebra is a Mal'tsev space introduced by Mal'tsev in 1954. Hence, applying the theorem of Reznichenko and Uspenskij on pseudocompact Mal'tsev spaces, we show that the product of arbitrary family of pseudocompact topological \(MV\)-algebras are pseudocompact. We also prove that every $σ$-compact topological \(MV\)-algebra is ccc.
